intro: The Winterhoof Cleansing Totem is a consecrated ritual implement crafted by Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village. Carved to undo the toxic blight spread by Venture Company intruders, it channels the Earth Mother's power to purify the polluted Winterhoof Water Well.

p: When the goblin engineers of the Venture Company encroached upon the plains of Mulgore, their industrial operations quickly tainted the land's precious subterranean water tables. In response, Mull Thunderhorn prepared the Winterhoof Cleansing Totem, imbuing the carved wood with protective magic intended to wash out the foreign poisons. Carried past hostile goblin guards to the edge of the Winterhoof Water Well, the totem disperses the contamination through a focused ritual, restoring pure drinking water to the wandering herds and native tribes of the plains.
